 Concert Music Festival 2027: Miguel Campello, God Save The Queen and the Ballet de Kiev go on sale this Friday; the line-up night by night
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 20 Nov 2026, 11:00 
 A 5-minute read 
 Concert Music Festival 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Miguel Campello, God Save The Queen and the Ballet de Kiev are on sale from this Friday at 12:00 on Ticketmaster: they perform on Thursday 29 July, Sunday 8 August and Sunday 15 August in Sancti Petri. 
 Concert Music Festival 2027 now has ten nights with a name , from Saturday 17 July with Camilo to Tuesday 17 August with Lucho RK, with two nights of David Bisbal, La Oreja de Van Gogh, Melendi and Alejandro Sanz, who announced this Friday that he will close his Spanish tour here on Saturday 31 July. 
 Four of those nights were previously sold blind with the “invisible artist” , and anyone who bought tickets for them now knows what they have got; 12 dates remain without a name, at €27.50. 
 The three new additions now have prices : standing for Miguel Campello costs €27.50, for God Save The Queen €38.50, and the Ballet de Kiev ranges from €55.10 to €69.30; for the rest, the cheapest ticket ranges from €38.50 for Lucho RK to €60.50 for standing at Camilo and La Oreja de Van Gogh. 
 A singer-songwriter who blends flamenco and rock, a Queen tribute and Swan Lake . The last three dates of the Concert Music Festival 2027 went on sale this Friday 20 November at 12:00 and broaden the Sancti Petri line-up, in Chiclana de la Frontera (Cádiz), beyond the Spanish-language pop that underpins it. With them, the festival already had nine nights with an artist between 17 July and 17 August, and some of them had previously been sold without a name.
 Festival guide 
 Concert Music Festival 2027 
 Dates to be confirmed · Poblado de Sancti Petri, Chiclana de la Frontera 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Mid-morning brought the tenth: Alejandro Sanz announced his 2027 tour of Spain, “¿Y ahora qué +?”, with twelve dates, the last of which is in Sancti Petri, on Saturday 31 July at 22:30 . His tickets go on sale on Tuesday 24 November at 10:00 , also on Ticketmaster.
 Campello, God Save The Queen and the Ballet de Kiev: the three nights on sale today
 All three are sold on Ticketmaster , the channel the festival website links to:
 Thursday 29 July, 22:30. Miguel Campello . The former singer of El Bicho presents Flamencura , his new album and the tour of the same name, which according to the sales listing blends flamenco rhythm with world music. A concert with a standing floor and numbered tiered seating.
 Sunday 8 August, 22:00. God Save The Queen . The Argentine Queen tribute band, with Front Stage and a standing floor, as well as tiered seating.
 Sunday 15 August, 22:00. Swan Lake, by the Ballet de Kiev . Viktor Ishchuk's Ballet de Kiev brings Tchaikovsky's ballet to the festival. It is the only one of the three nights sold entirely with numbered seats , from the front rows to the stands.
 God Save The Queen play Sancti Petri on Sunday 8 August. Image: Concert Music Festival. All three share the same conditions as the rest of the season: under-16s must be accompanied by their father, mother, guardian or a responsible adult, and 16- and 17-year-olds can attend on their own. Tickets for people with reduced mobility are requested by phone, on 930 49 75 00.
 The Concert Music Festival 2027 line-up, night by night
 This is how the calendar of concerts with an announced artist stands, according to the festival website and the venue's listings on Ticketmaster:
 Saturday 17 July, 22:30 : Camilo , on a tour that takes in several summer festivals in Spain .
 Saturday 24 July, 22:30 : David Bisbal , first night of the Tour Eternos.
 Sunday 25 July, 22:30 : David Bisbal , the second date the festival added in October .
 Thursday 29 July, 22:30 : Miguel Campello. New .
 Saturday 31 July, 22:30 : Alejandro Sanz , the final concert of his 2027 Spanish tour, with tickets from Tuesday 24 November at 10:00. New .
 Sunday 8 August, 22:00 : God Save The Queen. New .
 Tuesday 10 August, 22:00 : La Oreja de Van Gogh , with their 30th anniversary tour, which also stops at other festivals .
 Friday 13 August, 22:00 : Melendi , one of the five festival stops of his summer .
 Sunday 15 August, 22:00 : Swan Lake , by the Ballet de Kiev. New .
 Tuesday 17 August, 22:00 : Lucho RK , who put three festivals in the south on sale on Thursday .
 Until this week, the line-up was a succession of mainstream Spanish-language pop names, the same formula as 2026, with Pablo Alborán, Chayanne and Lola Índigo. The morning's three additions change the tone: a singer-songwriter with flamenco roots, a tribute act and a night of classical dance, two of them on a Sunday. Alejandro Sanz brings the line-up back to its big-name formula. All the practical information about this edition is on the Concert Music Festival page .
 Four nights that were sold blind now have a name
 29 July and 8, 15 and 17 August were on sale with the Invisible Artist promotion, which sells a ticket for a date without saying who is performing. None of those four appears on the list any longer. According to the conditions published by the festival, that ticket gives access to the event held on the chosen date, so anyone who bought blind for those nights now knows what they will see: Campello, God Save The Queen, the Ballet de Kiev or Lucho RK. Seats are allocated by the organisers, and there are no exchanges or refunds even if the artist does not appeal.
 12 dates remain on sale, at €27.50 on the Ticketmaster listings : 9 and 16 July, and 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 12, 14 and 16 August. 1 August, which was still on the list at midday, no longer appeared in the afternoon, with no artist announced. 14 August is shown with limited availability.
 Other nights from the original list have been removed without an artist being announced. 30 July joins those that had already disappeared in October: 10, 23 and 31 July, and 6 August. There is a precedent: 13 August was also removed from the promotion before the festival announced Melendi for that night. The festival has not said whether those dates are being held for new names, but one already was: 31 July, which left the promotion in October, is Alejandro Sanz's night.
 Prices for the nights with a name
 Since 12:00, Ticketmaster has been showing prices for the three new nights. Including the booking fees added by Ticketmaster, the cheapest ticket for each concert costs:
 Miguel Campello : €27.50 for standing and €33.10 for tiered seating.
 God Save The Queen : €38.50 for standing, €44.10 for tiered seating and €49.50 for Front Stage.
 Ballet de Kiev : between €55.10 and €69.30, depending on the area.
 Alejandro Sanz : no price until sales open on Tuesday 24 at 10:00. The Ticketmaster listing announces Front Stage and standing floor, numbered tiered seating and terraces.
 Lucho RK : €38.50 for standing and tiered seating in the first price tier; Front Stage, €66.
 Melendi : €55.10 for standing, €71.50 for tiered seating and €82.50 for Front Stage.
 David Bisbal : from €55.10 for a category E seat on the night of the 24th, up to €132 for premium. His concerts are all-seated.
 Camilo and La Oreja de Van Gogh : €60.50 for standing, €82.50 for tiered seating and €99.10 for Front Stage.
 Terraces for four people and boxes for six are sold separately and range from €630, for the terrace with drinks at Lucho RK, to €2,800, for the box at Camilo, Bisbal or La Oreja de Van Gogh. The €27.50 invisible artist ticket now costs the same as standing for Miguel Campello, the cheapest named ticket of the summer; the difference is that with the former you do not know who will walk out on stage.
